title: Juicy Savory Jamaican Falafel Wrap
description: A savory and fluffy Jamaican dish featuring falafel, lacquer-glaze, and low-calorie-friendly ingredients, wrapped in a warm pita bread.
instructions: In a food processor, combine chickpeas, flour, scallions, and jamaican jerk seasoning, and process until well combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 falafel patties.
Place the falafel patties on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
While the falafel is baking, warm the pita bread in the oven for 5 minutes.
Spread a tablespoon of lacquer-glaze on each pita bread.
Assemble the wrap by placing 2-3 falafel patties on each pita bread, followed by lettuce, tomato, and any other desired toppings.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
